campaign.title: M2 UNBAL actual-character one-sided band-limited majorant gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use only exact extremal-majorant statements whose Fourier convention, degree or exponential type, L1 excess, and pointwise direction are verified. A Beurling--Selberg or Vaaler slogan does not imply quadratic-form domination, actual-character cancellation, or an endpoint estimate.

frozen_target.question: Can a one-sided band-limited majorant, applied directly to the endpoint-complete full-character energy E_chi before any sectorwise modulus or positive-row norm, prove E_chi <<_epsilon X^(1/2+epsilon) uniformly on the literal flat-smooth strict-UNBAL packet; if not, what is the first exact order, bandwidth, character, or capacity obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: B_(p,n)=sum_(0<=a<H)b_(p,n+a), E_chi=C_H sum_n |sum_(p>0 odd)chi_4(p)B_(p,n)|^2. With A(k)=sum_p chi_4(p)b_(p,k), D_H(alpha)=sum_(0<=a<H)e(a alpha), and Ahat(alpha)=sum_k A(k)e(k alpha), Parseval gives E_chi=C_H int_0^1 |D_H(alpha)|^2 |Ahat(alpha)|^2 d alpha. Test only lawful one-sided domination of this exact quadratic form or of its literal physical selectors.
quantities: M asymp X, D=X^delta, L=X^ell, K=XL/D^2, H=ceil(X^(1/2)/D), K asymp LH^2
b_(p,k)=e(-1/8)M^(1/4)k^(-3/4)p^(-3/4)W((X/(2D))sqrt(p/(Mk)))q_L((X/M)p)e(sqrt(Mpk)) for positive odd p, zero-extended before shifts
C_H=(J+H-1)/H^2 asymp L and D_0=C_H H sum_(p,k)|b_(p,k)|^2 << X^(1/2)
E_chi is target-equivalent to the complete flat-smooth strict-UNBAL survivor modulo already-safe packages
the Fejer multiplier F_H=|D_H|^2 is itself a nonnegative trigonometric polynomial of degree H-1 and integral H
a meaningful bandwidth contraction must reduce degree below H by a fixed power without an L1, diagonal, endpoint, or owner loss
Gamma_before=min(H,Q) for the best separate positive-row elementary bound, Gamma_claimed=1, and every surviving factor must be displayed
flat-smooth strict-UNBAL owner only; hard, sharp, clipped, starred, arithmetic-owner, nonflat, and transition packets are excluded

completion_criteria: Reproduce the exact E_chi block-square and Parseval multiplier identities with the literal b_(p,k), chi_4 placement, zero extension, and normalization.
Classify every proposed majorant by the exact order relation it supplies: pointwise scalar, coefficientwise, Fourier-multiplier, positive-semidefinite quadratic-form, or actual-family-only.
For a trigonometric majorant T_Delta>=F_H, derive the sharp or sufficient lower bound on its zeroth coefficient from T_Delta(0)>=H^2, and price the bandwidth against the target.
Test whether a pointwise majorant of the physical interval or smooth support actually dominates a complex signed block square; supply a phase-adapted countercontrol if it does not.
If Poisson or completion is used on the majorant side, keep the actual chi_4-weighted p-sum and all moving profiles, and show a complete fixed-power contraction rather than transform inversion.
Test true chi_4, absolute characters, random signs, opposite-character identical rows, one-row coherent data, and the literal actual-symbol family separately.
Close under exactly one label: target_bound, strict_majorant_reduction, or majorant_no_go.
Make no complete-UNBAL, BAL, TOP, M9-M2, M1, endpoint, M9, quarter, or exponent promotion without the corresponding graph dependencies.

tasks.target: Independently determine whether a one-sided band-limited majorant can dominate the exact full-character block quadratic form with a fixed-power bandwidth contraction and target-safe zeroth coefficient; prove the target, a strict reduction, or the smallest rigorous uncertainty/cross-term no-go.
excluded_context: all Round-106 through Round-134 nonblind artifacts
required_output: An exact quadratic-form and Fourier-multiplier derivation.
A target estimate, strict noninvertible reduction, or quantified no-go.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Construct the strongest lawful one-sided Beurling--Selberg, Vaaler, or trigonometric-majorant inequality for the literal E_chi, then carry the actual chi_4-weighted p-sum through any finite Fourier or Poisson step and price the complete X exponent.
required_output: An exact table of majorant type, direction, Fourier support, zeroth coefficient, endpoint error, and capacity.
A proved complete bound, a strict smaller survivor, or the first invalid seam with an explicit remaining factor.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit every plausible one-sided majorant placement for order validity, complex cross terms, character retention, bandwidth uncertainty, diagonal capacity, Poisson ownership, and endpoint completeness.
required_output: A pass/fail matrix for every possible placement of the majorant.
The maximal safe theorem or exact fatal correction and surviving power.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

review_seams.requirement: The claimed one-sided comparison is an actual scalar or positive-semidefinite quadratic-form inequality; coefficientwise majorization is not used on a complex signed sum.
Fourier degree, zeroth coefficient, L1 excess, and the exact fixed-power bandwidth contraction are all explicit.
The p-sum retains chi_4 and moving profiles before every modulus, norm, or Poisson estimate.
The new inequality produces a strict smaller survivor; replacing F_H by itself or applying an invertible transform is recorded as a return.
Gamma_before, Gamma_claimed, Gamma_survivor, diagonal cost, and endpoint error are priced uniformly over the full UNBAL exponent polytope.
Only the flat-smooth strict-UNBAL owner may change state, and no downstream parent or exponent changes without all required bridges.
